title: SPARC - Setting up the BEADS for the Millipore Metabolic Rat Milliplex Assay
author: Doris Kemler

steps.title: Pre-wet the filter plate
steps.instruction: Pre-wet the filter plate for at least 10 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Add 75 µL assay buffer to each well using a teal (15-1250µl) Eclip tip.
Use only 6 pipette tips, pipetting twice in the same row (first in tube 1, then in tube 2).
Use pipette settings: Preset > stepper > pre-step, 75ul, 12x, 3, 4 (pulling up 900µl).
Set spacing to narrowest and add to every other row.
Perform mini drops on the plate to ensure liquids reach the bottom of the wells.
Replace plate lid, tape the plate securely to the blue shaker, and shake for at least 10 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare bead vials and materials
steps.instruction: Organize and prepare the bead vials and necessary labware.

substeps.instruction: Verify bead identity for each vial, noting active vs total forms of analytes.
Slightly unscrew and rescrew the lids (do not tighten fully).
Label a blue screw-top 5mL tube with 'mixed beads' and the date, then wrap it in aluminum foil for light protection.
Gather clean, dust-free trays labeled 'bead diluents 384 well half plate' and 'mixed beads tray'.
Fill the 'bead diluents 384 well half plate' with the entire vial of bead diluents.

steps.title: Sonicate and vortex beads
steps.instruction: Homogenize the bead samples using sonication and vortexing.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the Branson Sonicator water is at the water line level; top up with distilled H2O if necessary.
Place all 10 tubes in the multi-tube vortex holder and put the lid on.
Place the vortexer in a large bucket to prevent water splashing on the bench.
Sonicate samples for 30 seconds, ensuring caps do not get wet.
Vortex the tubes for 1 minute.

steps.title: Transfer and mix beads
steps.instruction: Transfer beads and diluents into the mixed bead tray using a specific pipetting sequence.

substeps.instruction: Place bead vials in an Eppendorf rack (5 tubes on each side) and open all lids.
Configure the clip-tip 15-1250µL teal electronic pipettor: Program Forward, Set volume = 100, Speed up = 5, Speed out = 2.
Set the pipette to the widest setting (12.9) and set up the tip box with 4 rows of 5 tips across.
For the first 5 bead vials (each containing 200µl):
Take up 100µl and dispense into the mixed bead tray (do not eject tips).
Take the remaining 100µl and dispense into the mixed bead tray.
Using new tips, rinse the tube twice with 100µl bead diluents each time, dispensing the rinses into the mixed bead tray.
Repeat the same process (transferring 100µl x 2, then rinsing 100µl x 2) for the second 5 bead vials.

steps.title: Final bead collection
steps.instruction: Mix the combined beads and transfer them to the protected storage tube.

substeps.instruction: Use a 1mL pipette to mix the beads in the tray thoroughly.
Transfer the mixed beads to the foil-wrapped 5mL tube.
